import json,traceback
stage="imports"
try:
 from cloud_store import FirestoreBackend,OperationsStore
 import cloud_providers as p
 from basecamp_cloud_auth import access_token
 stage="firestore"
 backend=FirestoreBackend(opt_in="yes")
 store=OperationsStore(backend)
 control=store.control()
 print(json.dumps({"stage":stage,"ok":True,"mode":control["mode"]}),flush=True)
 stage="dependencies"
 p._modules()
 print(json.dumps({"stage":stage,"ok":True}),flush=True)
 secrets=p.GoogleSecretManager()
 gmail=p.GmailSecretStore(secrets)
 stage="gmail_identity"
 result=p.verify_gmail_identity(gmail)
 print(json.dumps({"stage":stage,"ok":True,"result":result}),flush=True)
 stage="basecamp_credential"
 token=access_token(secrets,claim_refresh=store.claim_credential_refresh)
 print(json.dumps({"stage":stage,"ok":True}),flush=True)
 stage="basecamp_identity"
 result=p.verify_basecamp_internal(token)
 print(json.dumps({"stage":stage,"ok":True,"result":result}),flush=True)
except Exception as e:
 code=getattr(e,"code",None)
 if not isinstance(code,str) or not code.replace("_","").isalnum():code=None
 print(json.dumps({"stage":stage,"ok":False,"exception_type":type(e).__name__,"reason":code,"frames":[{"file":f.filename.split("/")[-1],"line":f.lineno,"function":f.name} for f in traceback.extract_tb(e.__traceback__)]}),flush=True)
 raise SystemExit(2)
